commits.author: ysolde
commits.message:
Start gaugemoor: plan, rules and decisions D1-D3

Seven phases in PHASES.md; the session rules; decisions and the station
list in PROJECT-CONTEXT.md. Brannock builds phase 1; Ferris leads and reviews.

ingest: Velcor VL-2 and Amsel 300 files into raw rows

UnknownFormat. Lines that do not parse come back as problems.

flatline check reports runs of one level for review.

The ledger remembers which drops a batch has processed, so a drop is
processed once. Manual edits come from data/edits.csv.
